scene: 院子里落满黄叶。She took a broom and swept the step.

definition_en: a boy or man with the same parents as you
core_image: 两个男孩并肩走在田埂上
scene: 夏天午后他们一起下河。My brother taught me to swim.
sceneCN: 这里 brother 是「兄弟」（第 1 个义项：同父母所生的男性）；句意是我哥哥教我游泳。

senses.title: A male sibling
senses.definition: a boy or man who has the same parents as you
senses.definitionCN: 与你同父母的男孩或男子
senses.example: My brother taught me to swim.
senses.exampleCN: 我哥哥教我游泳。
senses.why: This kinship sense is the oldest and still the central one.
senses.whyCN: 这一亲属义最古老，至今仍是核心义项。

senses.title: A close companion
senses.definition: a man who shares your work, cause or belief
senses.definitionCN: 与你共事、共志或同信的男子
senses.example: The two doctors called each other brother.
senses.exampleCN: 两位医生互称兄弟。
senses.why: Shared work and hardship made close partners feel like family.
senses.whyCN: 共事与共患难让亲密的伙伴有了家人的感觉。

senses.title: A fellow believer

senses.why: Religious groups called members brothers to mark spiritual kinship.
senses.whyCN: 宗教团体用「兄弟」称呼成员，以表示属灵上的亲缘。

definition_en: the part of the face above the eyes
core_image: 汗珠从额角滑下来
scene: 正午的太阳晒得人发晕。Sweat ran down his brow in the heat.
sceneCN: 这里 brow 是「额头」（第 1 个义项：眼睛上方的部位）；句意是炎热中汗水顺着他的额头流下。

senses.title: The forehead
senses.definition: the part of the face above the eyes
senses.example: Sweat ran down his brow in the heat.
senses.exampleCN: 炎热中汗水顺着他的额头流下。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, naming the smooth front of the head.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，指头部前方平滑的那一块。

senses.title: The eyebrow
senses.definition: the line of hair above the eye
senses.example: He raised a brow at the strange answer.
senses.exampleCN: 听到这个奇怪的回答，他挑起了眉毛。
senses.why: The hair above the eye sat on the brow, so the part gave it its name.
senses.whyCN: 眼上的毛长在额头上，于是这块部位把名字给了它。

senses.title: The top edge of a hill
senses.definition: the upper edge or steep face of a hill
senses.example: The house sat on the brow of the hill.
senses.exampleCN: 那座房子坐落在山坡顶上。
senses.why: A hill's rounded top looks like a forehead above the land.
senses.whyCN: 浑圆的山顶看起来像大地之上的额头。
